olivia: Quick sync 1: Aurora Systems customer story + benchmark highlights. Aim to publish a short case + webinar teaser next Thursday. Need final quote + legal sign-off by Tuesday EOD.
sam: Aurora ran our end-to-end benchmark on the 7B quantized profile. Reported 24% lower cost-per-token and steady p95 latency under 220ms. Will attach summary.
harry: Customer prefers a product-oriented line from their lead engineer, not marketing-speak. They can provide a 20-30 word quote and a 20s recorded clip.
legal: Please attach the benchmark artifact and an email from the customer with explicit permission to publish the quote and clip. We'll flag any phrasing that implies guaranteed savings.
sam: Uploaded run_id: AUR-2026-04-02-2, sample=8k requests, models=7B-qtz-v1. I'll add anonymized CSV to the PR.
olivia: Draft hero sentence suggestion: "Aurora Systems cut inference costs and kept latency predictable, enabling faster feature rollouts." Any edits?
harry: Change to: "Aurora Systems reduced per-token costs by ~24% while maintaining stable p95 latency, speeding feature rollout"
olivia: That works. Sam, can you confirm the exact wording for the metric (24% on average) so legal is happy?
sam: Confirmed: "reduced on average by 24% during a 4-week pilot (n=4 models)". Customer approved similar phrasing in their email.
legal: Pre-approve that phrasing pending we get the signed email. Once received, turnaround ~3 hours.
calendar-bot: Reminder: draft review Tue 10:00-10:30. Webinar teaser scheduled Thu 2026-04-09 09:00 PT.
olivia: Checklist: 1) Signed customer approval email (Harry) 2) Benchmark artifact (Sam) 3) Engineer quote + clip (Harry) 4) Blog + social draft (Sam) 5) Legal sign-off (Legal). High priority.
harry: I'll ping the customer now and follow up here.
olivia: Thanks team :thumbsup:
